overall_assessment: All 14 packet entries were reviewed (9 suspects and 5 controls): most top-level sections and all displayed learning-outcome groups are preserved, but practice plans have substantive allocation errors, including two affected random controls. The assessment leak flags for BS-PLVI30 and OKLI3014 are genuine; the V-RETT8200 reading-list blob, KH-EMNE2 short prerequisite, IA4212 teaching-method leak and 050-E11 internal coursework labels are false alarms, and the visible MG1NA3/UHULV reading-list leaks are bibliographic titles. Unflagged admission-only prerequisites, administrative assessment text and widespread library metadata also need attention; packet caps limit completeness checks and prevent a firm judgment on the unseen MAR4020 reading-list leak, and were not treated as extractor truncation.

findings.description: Two plans have logical sections split across incorrect boundaries. In BS-PLVI30, coursework_requirements stops during Arbeidskrav 1; assessment begins with its Faglige krav and contains its remaining criteria and the full descriptions of Arbeidskrav 2 and 3. These are approval requirements, not final assessment components. In the random SMERTE100 control, assessment starts with subject-matter bullets and Hovedtema 16, which belong to course_content. This is visible misallocation, not an inference from packet truncation.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/blocks.R::.text_blocks() lets any blank-separated heading-shaped line switch sections through substring matching in R/section_heading_map.R. An internal label such as Kriterier for vurdering therefore opens assessment and later Arbeidskrav N labels cannot restore the original section because .heading_shaped_line() rejects digits. A similar spurious switch within the numbered subject themes likely explains SMERTE100; its triggering source line is outside the displayed full-plan prefix.
findings.suggested_fix: For USN text plans with a table of contents, retain the enclosing TOC section until another repeated TOC heading opens a section. Treat local criteria labels within an arbeidskrav as content of coursework_requirements, and keep numbered Hovedtema headings and their topic bullets within course_content. Avoid globally mapping every occurrence of vurdering to final assessment.

findings.evidence: Dokumentere tilstedeværelse for minimum 8 dager (til sammen 60 timer) i praksis.
findings.description: Source practice blocks are assigned wholesale rather than by meaning. In 050-E11 and BS-PLVI30, teaching_methods includes compulsory attendance, absence limits and attendance documentation; 050-E11 also includes the graded clinical pass/fail decision. In SMERTE100, teaching_methods contains required preparation, a reflection note, 60 hours of documented attendance and approval of observation practice, which the exam section explicitly identifies as an access gate. These requirements belong to coursework_requirements, and the clinical grading statement belongs to assessment. Conversely, the random PPUDPRA1 course_content includes substantial supervision, feedback and individual/group placement arrangements that belong to teaching_methods.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R already maps Praksis to teaching_methods, and sectionize() retains the entire block there. Faglig innhold similarly assigns mixed introductory prose to course_content. The USN text configuration has no paragraph-level routing to separate practice arrangements, compulsory gates and final clinical assessment.
findings.suggested_fix: Add USN routing within mixed practice blocks: move complete attendance/absence and required-documentation paragraphs to coursework_requirements, and explicit final clinical grading statements to assessment. Move clearly identified supervision/feedback and individual/group placement sentences from mixed course-content introductions to teaching_methods. Preserve actual practice learning activities in teaching_methods and substantive subject topics in course_content.

findings.evidence: Arbeidskrav inngår ikke i karakteren, men må utføres eller være godkjent innen satte frister for at emnet skal være bestått.
findings.description: Assessment retains inline approval gates in three courses: OKLI3014 explicitly says arbeidskrav do not contribute to the grade; 050-E11 says all arbeidskrav must be approved; SMERTE100 lists attendance, an approved test, written coursework and approved observation practice as conditions for the final exam. These sentences belong to coursework_requirements. The 050-E11 assessment also repeats the requirement to pass preceding clinical courses, which belongs to prerequisites. This confirms the OKLI3014 leak flag and exposes additional unflagged contamination.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R::page_sections() only runs .split_inline_coursework() when section_inline_coursework is enabled, which the USN configuration does not enable. .split_inline_prerequisites() operates only on course_content, so prerequisite statements embedded in assessment are not routed either.
findings.suggested_fix: Enable and extend USN inline routing for complete gate sentences beginning Arbeidskrav inngår ikke i karakteren, Alle arbeidskrav må være godkjent and For å avlegge avsluttende eksamen. Move prior-course pass requirements to prerequisites. Restrict the rules to approval/access conditions: preserve graded portfolios and tests, including the FK-FYS0001 portfolio worth 40 percent of the final grade.

findings.evidence: Dersom kandidaten vurderes til ikke bestått i en praksisperiode kan denne praksisperioden kun tas opp igjen en gang.
findings.description: Assessment contains administrative rules that belong to no canonical section: PPUDPRA1 includes repeat-attempt limits, loss of study right and pointers to rules for failed/aborted practice; BS-PLVI30 includes the requirement to retake failed or interrupted practice in its entirety. course_plan_spec.md explicitly excludes resit and study-right logistics from sections while retaining them in the full plan. The PPUDPRA1 random control shows that these defects are not restricted to flagged rows.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: These are running sentences under an assessment heading, so heading-level .drop rules cannot remove them. R/extract_sections.R::.section_noise$usn only targets the detailed fitness-to-practise notice, and there is no USN entry in .logistics_sentences for practice resit/study-right text.
findings.suggested_fix: Add narrowly anchored USN assessment cleanup for practice repeat-attempt limits, study-right loss, retaking failed/aborted practice and their administrative cross-reference lines. Remove these sentences only from section output; retain the actual grading design, pass criteria, durations and permitted aids.

findings.description: IA4212 emits a prerequisites row consisting solely of a reference to general admission requirements. It states no subject-matter prior knowledge or prior course and should not count as a present prerequisites section. The teaching_methods leak flag on this course is a false alarm: its sentence actually describes lectures, laboratory work and exercises; the real prerequisite defect was unflagged.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R::.strip_admission_lines() relies on .admission_line_regex, which recognizes an initial opptakskrav but not the phrase Generelle opptakskrav. The surviving sentence also is not a recognized placeholder.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend .admission_line_regex with an anchored, case-insensitive match for generelle opptakskrav with optional terminal punctuation, then let .clean_sections() drop the empty row. Keep sentences that contain genuine prior-knowledge or prior-course requirements.

findings.description: All ten displayed substantive reading lists retain library-list identity metadata: a course title/code and usually a campus; the Fysikk 0 control also retains LREAL Kull. These are catalogue/course identity labels rather than references or syllabus instructions. This is minor recurring noise, not evidence that the long lists or bibliography-title leak flags are themselves failures. Topic groupings, assigned chapters and reading instructions remain meaningful and should be preserved.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R::.strip_list_tabs() removes repeated leading tab labels only when they recur later. A single list header, or an identity header after an introductory syllabus note, survives the cleanup.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend USN reading-list cleanup to remove standalone library identity lines verified against the current course title/code and optional campus, and standalone cohort labels such as LREAL Kull. Handle headers after introductory notes as well as leading headers, while retaining bibliography entries and substantive syllabus grouping labels.
